about: What the frozen code sprite sprites/scatter-pellet.js drew and answered in every call the tests that read it made, recorded so the code can go (docs/data-sprites.md section 5, R2b/R3). From the frozen copy tests/fixtures/code-sprites/scatter-pellet.js (a word-for-word copy of the library's sprites/scatter-pellet.js as it was before its redraw; the working tree of 2026-11-21 on top of commit abbc3db). Frames: palette indices, little-endian 16-bit, deflated, base64 (palette[0] is "no pixel"); calls: answers of fps(), sockets(), slice() and textArea(), JSON text or null. Keys: first 16 hex digits of the SHA-1 of the call's sorted-key JSON (tests/helpers/code-replay.mjs callKey). Read by tests/helpers/code-replay.mjs replaySprite(id). Recorded by: projectile-writers, projectile-pellet-pixels.

def.name: Scatter pellet
def.blurb: One small shot from a scatter gun: a bright dot with a short tail, drawn pointing right so a game can turn it to any angle; it pops into four sparks. Change its size, shape, tail and colours.
